intro: Barnil Stonepot needs assistance gathering missing leaves from the second section of Hemet Nesingwary's scattered hunting manuscript. Having gathered most of the parchment himself, he relies on travelers across Stranglethorn Vale to recover the remaining scattered accounts of panther and tiger hunts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Chapter II was chock full of exciting tales of panther and tiger hunting. I could just kick myself for letting the pages blow away!
It seems I was able to recover all of the pages with the exception of pages 10, 11, 14, and 16.

clips.title: Progress
paras: We still need pages 10, 11, 14 and 16 to complete Chapter II, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Chapter II is finally complete! Well done!
